title: How We Finally Looked Inside AI
excerpt: For years, AI felt like a black box. You type something in, it does something out. Magic.
content:
For years, AI felt like a black box. You type something in, it does something out. Magic.

But magic is unsatisfying when you're trying to build with it.

So we built a microscope.

Not a metaphorical one. A literal one. Sort of.

...

### The Sandbox

We gave the model a goal: manage emails. It had tools, memory, and internet access.

title: The Death of Tutorials
excerpt: Why traditional structured tutorials are quickly becoming obsolete in the age of generative learning.
content:
Why traditional structured tutorials are quickly becoming obsolete in the age of generative learning.

When information was scarce, linear step-by-step guides were the only way to master complex tools. Today, interactive synthesis and direct experimentation have replaced static walkthroughs.

title: Why Most AI Demos Feel Fake
excerpt: The gap between curated product demos and real-world edge cases in autonomous software systems.
content:
The gap between curated product demos and real-world edge cases in autonomous software systems.

Most demos are cherry-picked happy paths. Real engineering happens at the messy boundaries of unpredictable state and uncurated user input.
